kpis.description_fr: Production d'uranium concentré U3O8 (livres). Reprise post-pause 2014-2022 grâce White Mesa Mill + Pinyon Plain + La Sal. Stratégie de réponse au DOE / Russia ban.
kpis.description_en: Concentrated uranium U3O8 production (lbs). Restart post 2014-2022 pause thanks to White Mesa Mill + Pinyon Plain + La Sal. Strategic response to DOE / Russia ban.

kpis.description_fr: Production néodyme-praséodyme oxide (NdPr). Sortie commerciale 2024 = première production US séparée de terres rares pour aimants permanents EV/eolien. Pivot stratégique unique.
kpis.description_en: Neodymium-praseodymium (NdPr) oxide production. 2024 commercial output = first US separated rare earth production for EV/wind permanent magnets. Unique strategic pivot.
kpis._specific_to: Energy Fuels / NdPr rare earths US

kpis.description_fr: Inventaire physique U3O8 fini. Stockage stratégique pour vente opportuniste prix spot. Levier mark-to-market sur prix uranium (~70-90 $/lb).
kpis.description_en: Physical finished U3O8 inventory. Strategic stockpile for opportunistic spot-price sales. Mark-to-market leverage on uranium price (~$70-90/lb).

kpis.description_fr: Capacité licence usine de traitement White Mesa (Utah). Seul mill uranium opérationnel licence aux USA. Avantage compétitif structurel + revenus alternate feed.
kpis.description_en: White Mesa (Utah) processing mill licensed capacity. Only operationally-licensed uranium mill in USA. Structural competitive moat + alternate feed revenues.
kpis._specific_to: Energy Fuels / White Mesa Mill monopole US

kpis_story.description_fr: Production NdPr oxide démarrée 2024 à White Mesa (premier US hors China). Cible 1000 t/an. Soutien gouvernement US (DoE, DoD). Catalyseur structurel.
kpis_story.description_en: NdPr oxide production started 2024 at White Mesa (first US ex-China). 1000 t/year target. US government support (DoE, DoD). Structural catalyst.
kpis_story._specific_to: UUUU US rare earths supply chain

_notes: Energy Fuels : pivot stratégique uranium reprise + entrée rare earths (NdPr séparation). White Mesa Mill = seul mill US licencié = moat structurel.
